skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply theories of economic growth models to explain the origins of economic growth in various countries.
Develop skills in data collection, secondary literature synthesis, and using economic tools for practical research.
Enhance independent research, teamwork, and presentation skills to convey knowledge through writing and discussing real-world economic growth scenarios.
Evaluate the role of productivity, technology, and public policy in economic growth.
Improve self-study and research abilities to enhance knowledge on economic growth issues in practice.
Develop collaboration and responsibility in group activities, and form personal critical perspectives on growth models in practice.
